findings.detail: The metadata probes inspect a symlink rather than its target. If input.json points to source.json, rendering input.json onto source.json compares different inode identities and then replaces the underlying JSON with HTML. The mode probe similarly reads a symlink's permissions instead of its private target's permissions, potentially making the replacement page readable by others. These defects predate this range; the branch adds exception comments without correcting them.
findings.evidence: The stat calls at lines 1363 and 1478-1479 omit -L. The installed /usr/share/man/man1/stat.1 documents lstat as the default and -L as selecting the target. The differing identities bypass line 1480, after which write_output renames HTML onto source.json. The base revision contains the same executable statements.
findings.title: Sibling input forms: metadata probes do not follow symlinks

findings.detail: Failure of both stat variants leaves protections disabled while writing continues. With stat unavailable on PATH, rendering an existing 0600 page under umask 022 replaces it with a 0644 page. Using the same input and output path also bypasses the identity guard and overwrites the JSON. These defects predate this range; the new annotations approve the existing fallbacks.
findings.evidence: Line 1363 converts both probe failures to an empty mode; lines 1365-1367 substitute permissions from the current umask, which lines 1372-1373 apply before replacement. Lines 1478-1480 likewise turn failed identity reads into a skipped guard. require_jq does not require stat. The base revision has identical failure handling.
findings.title: Absent or partial data: failed metadata probes bypass file protections

findings.detail: The repository-mismatch diagnostic prints the complete origin URL. Gathering acme/widgets from a checkout whose origin is https://user:SECRET@github.com/acme/other.git therefore exposes its embedded credential on stderr. This defect predates this range and remains in the newly annotated mismatch path.
findings.evidence: Line 1054 captures git remote get-url origin without sanitizing it. Lines 1055-1056 place the raw value in local-notice.txt, which lines 1336-1337 print to stderr. The sibling backlog-gather mismatch diagnostic names only the expected repository. The base revision contains the same raw-URL diagnostic.
findings.title: Untrusted data in commands: the origin diagnostic exposes URL credentials

findings.detail: Both gather scripts pass relative filenames beginning with a dash directly to jq. For example, backlog-gather finish -gather.json analysis.json output.json rejects a valid existing gather because jq interprets its filename as an option. bugs-gather has the same problem with saved inputs and assessments. This defect predates this range; report-board already normalizes this sibling input form.
findings.evidence: backlog-gather's cmd_finish passes its arguments unchanged to require_json_file, whose line 327 supplies the path directly to jq. bugs-gather repeats this at line 876 and in require_assessments at line 1394. report-board's operand function instead prefixes dash-leading filenames with ./ before readers use them. The base revision contains the same unnormalized gather readers.
findings.title: Sibling input forms: gather readers treat dash-leading filenames as options
